quarterly_data.signal: 20-F foundry concentration (foundries not named): as a fabless IC design company Canaan outsources IC fabrication; wafers purchased from two major third-party foundry partners accounted for 57.8% of its total procurement in 2025, versus 64.0% from one major foundry partner in 2024 and 55.2% in 2023. Products sold from Malaysia to the United States face a 12.6% tariff and products sold from China to the United States a 37.6% tariff as of the date of the report.
